proposal.reason: Primary change removes CollNet execution end-to-end: CollNet net-plugin loading, CollNet transport/proxy resources, and related connection paths are deleted (network, transport). The PR also removes CollNet device-kernel implementations while preserving a reserved algorithm slot (kernels), drops CollNet logical graph construction/connection and CollNet-specific topology discovery metadata (graph-search, device-topology), and updates built-in algorithm/protocol selection and performance tables to disable CollNet and keep slot compatibility (tuning). External tuner callback compatibility is explicitly handled by validating unsupported/out-of-range selections and falling back to internal tuning while preserving v1 IDs/layout expectations (tuner-plugin).
